GET /api/procedures/{id} accepts only 24-char ObjectId hex strings (bson.errors.InvalidId raised otherwise). Kept seed using ObjectId as required.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py get_procedure() uses ObjectId(procedure_id) with no try/except: passing any non-hex 24-char id yields a 500 (bson.errors.InvalidId). Consider validating id and returning 400/404 instead of 500. (Pre-existing; not introduced by iter-402.)
